en.text:
Aiming Down Sights charges an 'Amalgamation Round' over the course of 1 second. When charged, fire an extremely dense shot that deals <pve 290% /> <pvp [18%] /> increased damage and marks the target for all allies for 5 seconds.

This gun deals <pve 95% /> <pvp [6.7%] /> increased Spread Shot damage and <pve 30% /> <pvp [6.7%] /> increased Amalgamation Round damage to marked targets

Defeating a marked target with this gun or scoring a precision kill with an Amalgamation Round grants <void/>Void Invisibility for 7 seconds (10.5 with <void/>Echo of Persistence) and <void/>Truesight for 4 seconds.
